items.q: How long do the results last?
items.a: Results can vary from person to person depending on individual factors and lifestyle habits.

items.q: Can I go back to work the same day?
items.a: Many people are able to return to their normal activities shortly after treatment, depending on their individual circumstances.

items.q: Can Botox help prevent expression lines?
items.a: It may help reduce the formation and appearance of dynamic expression lines.

items.q: Can Full Face Botox be combined with other treatments?
items.a: Yes. Depending on your individual assessment, Botox may be combined with other aesthetic treatments.
Certain activities may need to be avoided during the first few hours. We provide personalized post-treatment recommendations based on your procedure.
